prompt.text:
Implement voxel geometry utilities in `solution.rs` using only the standard library. Expose `pub type Cell = (i32, i32, i32)`, `pub fn exposed_faces(cells: &[Cell]) -> usize`, and `pub fn exterior_faces(cells: &[Cell]) -> usize`. Duplicate cells represent one cube. Face adjacency differs by exactly one on one axis. `exposed_faces` counts every cube face not touching another cube, including faces bordering sealed cavities. `exterior_faces` counts only faces reachable by air from outside. It must work for negative coordinates and coordinates at `i32::MIN` or `i32::MAX` without overflowing. Empty input returns zero. Neither function may mutate the slice, and results must be independent of input ordering.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
